artboards.title: D — How much story you get

annotations.text:
The problem: width-as-thickness is abstract — it never said what an omnibus IS.

Five directions, roughly least to most adventurous. A and D are compatible: A answers "how big is the book", D answers "do I get the whole story". C is the one that shrinks the section most.

Every option also has to be cheaper than the current nine tall cards.

The problem: the collapsed "What is this?" bar reads like a breadcrumb, and unfurling it shows exactly the copy you wanted gone.

All three are once-per-page, keyed on panel:seen:<route>, skippable on any key or click, and disabled entirely under prefers-reduced-motion (they fall back to the page, no intro).

Each frame is a moment in the animation, left to right.
